notes: «عنه» opens the report and refers back to report 136 (prev1), whose first name is محمد بن إسحاق المقري; that name is taken over as inherited (the next name, المقانعي, matches prev1).
«يعني أبا الصديق» is an editor's gloss and is left out. «قال رسول الله» ends the chain at the Prophet, who is not a link.
Route differs from prev1 at «تليد» (prev1 writes «المعلى بن زياد»); the text is read as written.
